name: kyc-name-match
title: KYC Name Match
description: KYC name field that compares the typed name with each document word by word (order, initials, missing middle name, transliterations like Laxmi/Lakshmi), checks the PAN's 4th and 5th letters, flags differing date of birth or gender, and offers each exact name.

meta.stops: Helps prevent a KYC rejection for a name mismatch
meta.summary: Compares the typed name with each KYC document word by word and checks the PAN letters, so a KYC or PAN–Aadhaar link doesn't fail on a name mismatch.
meta.server: Run the real name match and KYC verification through your provider on the server, and avoid storing full Aadhaar numbers.
catches: Words in a different order, initials, or a missing middle name
Transliteration variants such as Laxmi and Lakshmi
PAN 4th letter that doesn't match the holder type (P for an individual)
PAN 5th letter that doesn't match the surname's first letter
Date of birth or gender that differs between documents
limits: Compares the document details you pass; it doesn't read or verify the documents
Transliteration matching covers common variants only
Whether a minor mismatch passes is decided by UIDAI or the KYC provider, not this check
a11y: Visible label; input has aria-invalid on a mismatch and is described by the hint and summary
Each document's use-exact-name button is described by that document's row
Status uses role=status; icons are aria-hidden

sources.label: Income Tax Department: How PAN is formed

rules.note: Informational; check the official source. Confirmed: 4th character is the holder status (P individual, C company, etc.), 5th is the first letter of an individual's surname. The UIDAI FAQ on PAN–Aadhaar name, gender and date-of-birth matching was not re-fetched this round.
